snp5.7:1.1: Alone, Sakyan, with nothing to rely on,
snp5.7:1.3:
I can’t venture across
the great flood.
snp5.7:1.4:
Tell me, All-around Eye,
the support to rely on
snp5.7:2.1:
The Buddha:
Mindfully focused on nothingness,
snp5.7:2.3:
relying on ‘There isn’t,’
you should cross over the flood.
snp5.7:2.5:
keep watch for the ending of
craving, night & day.
snp5.7:3.1:
Upasīva:
One free from passion
for all sensuality
snp5.7:3.3: relying on nothingness, letting go of all else,
snp5.7:3.4: released in the highest emancipation of perception:
snp5.7:4.1:
The Buddha:
One free from passion
for all sensuality
snp5.7:4.3: relying on nothingness, letting go of all else,
snp5.7:4.4: released in the highest emancipation of perception:
snp5.7:5.1:
Upasīva:
If, All-around Eye, he stays there,
unaffected
snp5.7:5.3:
right there
would he be cooled & released?
snp5.7:5.4: Would his consciousness be like that?
snp5.7:6.1:
The Buddha:
As a flame overthrown by the force of the wind
snp5.7:6.3:
goes to an end
that cannot be classified,
snp5.7:6.4: so the sage freed from the name-body
snp5.7:6.5:
goes to an end
that cannot be classified.
snp5.7:7.1:
Upasīva:
One who has reached the end:
Does he not exist,
snp5.7:7.2:
or is he for eternity
free from dis-ease?
snp5.7:7.3: Please, sage, declare this to me
snp5.7:7.4: as this phenomenon has been known by you.
snp5.7:8.1:
The Buddha:
One who has reached the end
has no criterion
snp5.7:8.3:
by which anyone would say that—
for him it doesn’t exist.
snp5.7:8.4: When all phenomena are done away with,
snp5.7:8.5:
all means of speaking
are done away with as well.
